pages.text: If you are reading this, you woke as I did: on cold ground, with empty hands and a sky that did not care. I won't tell you who I was. It matters less than what I learned.
This world is built in ages, like the rings of a tree. Each one stays locked until you have earned the one before it. Not by a door or a guard, but by what you know how to make.
I wrote this as I climbed: some pages in charcoal, some in ink, a few in a hand shaking from cold or fear. Each chapter opens when you reach its age. I couldn't bear to spoil them for you.
One more thing. The road ends somewhere. I know where, and I know what waits there. I never reached it. Perhaps you will.
